title: Adjunction transposes a commutative square
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be categories [def-nagata-category], and let $L:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$, $R:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ be functors with an adjunction, specified by natural bijections
$$\Phi_{U,V}:\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal D}(LU,V)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(U,RV).$$
Let $X',X\in\mathcal C$, $Y,Y'\in\mathcal D$, and let $f:X'\to X$, $s:X\to RY'$, $t:X'\to RY$, $k:Y\to Y'$ be morphisms. Then
$$\Phi_{X,Y'}^{-1}(s)\circ L(f)=k\circ\Phi_{X',Y}^{-1}(t)\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad s\circ f=R(k)\circ t.$$
No monoidal structure or invertibility of $f,k,s,t$ is assumed.
